description: Turn auto top-up on or off, or change it: when the balance drops below `threshold_usd`, the saved card adds `amount_usd`, up to `monthly_max_usd` per month. Needs an API key and a card saved at checkout. The monthly cap cannot be raised above $500 here.

amount_usd.description: Dollars to add each time (from 10; $100+ adds 10% bonus).

enabled.description: true to turn auto top-up on, false to turn it off.

monthly_max_usd.description: Monthly spending cap in USD (at most 500).

threshold_usd.description: Top up when the balance drops below this many dollars (default 1).

name: contextfetch_auto_reload
title: ContextFetch auto-reload
